reason: A mobile-focused DSH Web interface adaptation that changes responsive layout, navigation drawer behavior, gestures, composer presentation, and PWA integration while stating that desktop layouts are unaffected.

summaries.zh: 为 DSH Web 提供移动端界面适配，包括玻璃风格布局、侧栏抽屉、拖动手势、输入框优化及 PWA 支持。
summaries.en: Adapts the DSH Web interface for mobile devices with a glass-style layout, reveal drawer, drag gestures, composer improvements, and PWA support.

capabilities: Modifies mobile web interface layout and interactions
Adds responsive drawer, drag gestures, and composer behavior
Injects a Service Worker and web manifest
Caches selected static plugin and asset resources
